baseline_counterfactual.geometry: Actual robot collision hulls and articulated gripper meshes; exact USD cylinders/cubes/capsules and original hazard meshes. Coarse arm/finger capsules and primitive world-AABBs cannot establish necessity.

path_comparison.method: 101 normalized-progress samples; necessity determined by geometric counterfactual, never by path difference alone

pregrasp_validation.checks: cuRobo constraints and independent FCL planning clearances at all dense samples
cuRobo constraints and independent FCL planning clearances at all dense samples

sampling: Baseline original observed states before and after each 15 Hz action; augmented actual robot and moving door recorded at every 120 Hz physics step plus action postchecks. Unsafe baseline never executed with hazards.

variant_spec.name: glass
variant_spec.semantic_anchor: Original successful pregrasp actually intersects added source geometry. Fixed baseline task, layout, target and control policy; independent paired planning and physical audits required.
